snippet_primary: "At the end of August, I had to cancel 7 orders to the USA because I wasn't yet set up with a proper solution for handling the new US tariff/duty requirements. It was a really difficult decision, but I didn't want to risk non-compliance or surprise charges for my customers. Thankfully, 4 of those customers asked me to reserve their items and were very understanding."
subject_exact: International Etsy seller cancelled 7 US orders in August 2025 due to inability to comply with new US tariff/duty requirements; 4 of those customers requested item reserves
